parole.testo: Borrowed from a South Slavic language, from Latin cerrus. Compare Serbo-Croatian cer (“Turkey oak”).

parole.significato: a type of small round cake, similar to a kind of scone
parole.testo: Via a South Slavic language, ultimately from the feminine form of Latin focācius (“of the hearth, baked on a fire”), from Latin focus (“hearth, fireplace”). Compare Serbo-Croatian pogača (“unleavened bread”), Bulgarian погача (pogača), Macedonian погача (pogača, “unleavened bread”). Cognates in Roma
